name: Plex Watch-State Migration
description: Migrate watched flags and resume positions per user from a Plex server into Matinee. The owner and Plex Home users migrate fully. External shared accounts migrate watched flags from the server history.
author: Anna Reber

config.label: Plex server URL
config.description: For example http://plex.local:32400 or https://192.168.1.10:32400. No trailing slash.

config.label: Accept self-signed certificates
config.description: Skips certificate verification for the Plex server. Only for a server whose certificate is not signed by a CA this server trusts.

config.label: Connect Plex account
config.description: Shows a code to enter at https://plex.tv/link. The Connection row updates once the link completes.

config.label: Plex token (manual fallback)
config.description: Paste an owner X-Plex-Token instead of using the link flow.

config.label: User matching
config.description: Drag a Matinee user onto a Plex user to migrate that pair. Unassigned users are skipped.

config.label: Mirror the source exactly (may unwatch items in Matinee)
config.description: Off = only set watched flags and resume positions, never unwatch.
